installed_skills.name: Intentional frontend design
installed_skills.author: Anthropic; adapted by Coffee Management System maintainers
installed_skills.why: A reputable, script-free design workflow. Scoped to explicitly requested custom web surfaces so it cannot replace Flutter or add React.
installed_skills.changes: Renamed and narrowed; removed design-studio/client assumptions and mandatory novelty/two-pass rules; added existing-stack and POS usability constraints.

installed_skills.name: Feature-first Flutter
installed_skills.author: The Flutter Authors; adapted by Coffee Management System maintainers
installed_skills.date: 2026-04-21: architecture/layout skill additions; repository remains active
installed_skills.why: Official Flutter separation-of-concerns and constraint-based layout guidance directly fits phone/tablet POS work.
installed_skills.changes: Preserved project feature-first data/domain/presentation layout; removed mandatory ChangeNotifier, code generation and DI-package choices, model metadata and unsafe example caching assumptions; added SDK-version/state-lifecycle checks.

installed_skills.name: Laravel REST API
installed_skills.author: Laravel / Taylor Otwell; adapted by Coffee Management System maintainers
installed_skills.date: 2026-09-30: relevant skill-subtree command/template maintenance; 2026-09-04: action-example revision
installed_skills.why: Framework-maintainer guidance covers actual Laravel boundaries without a generic repository layer. Useful validation, authorization, query and provider rules.
installed_skills.changes: Removed search-docs/MCP assumptions, Blade template execution and uninstalled skill links; condensed rules to versioned REST conventions and existing Services layout. No Boost package or generator installed.

installed_skills.name: MySQL design
installed_skills.kind: Original project skill; documentation references only
installed_skills.author: Coffee Management System maintainers; references by Oracle/MySQL and Laravel
installed_skills.date: Local skill created 2026-10-05. Exact manual-page meaningful update unavailable; server repository push is not a manual update.
installed_skills.why: Version-aware schema/query/transaction decisions fit MySQL and financial invariants better than bulk imported database recipes.
installed_skills.changes: Written for this monorepo; no upstream skill, manual excerpt, SQL account-management script or MySQL code vendored.

installed_skills.name: Accessible Cambodian POS
installed_skills.kind: Original project skill; documentation references only
installed_skills.author: Coffee Management System maintainers; references by W3C, Flutter Authors and National Bank of Cambodia
installed_skills.date: Local skill created 2026-10-05. Normative reference is WCAG 2.2; upstream repository activity is tracked separately.
installed_skills.why: Operational cashier UX, Khmer script and accessibility need a small local acceptance workflow rather than a generic style-generator database.
installed_skills.changes: Local ergonomic/device scenarios and product decision boundaries. No copied WCAG/Flutter/NBC text, font, image, executable design search or final Khmer translation.

installed_skills.name: Practical system design
installed_skills.kind: Original project skill; documentation references only
installed_skills.author: Coffee Management System maintainers; references by Flutter and Laravel
installed_skills.date: Local skill created 2026-10-05; no independently maintained upstream skill is claimed.
installed_skills.why: Owns cross-app decisions, transactions/durability and failure boundaries while Flutter/Laravel skills own implementation details.
installed_skills.changes: Original decision workflow respecting the current architecture; avoids hypothetical tenancy, offline POS and distributed systems.

installed_skills.name: Evidence-based code review
installed_skills.author: Flutter agent-plugins contributors (Reid Baker agent workflow); adapted by Coffee Management System maintainers
installed_skills.date: 2026-05-08: core review workflow added; 2026-05-11: related writing-reference maintenance
installed_skills.why: An evidence/context/self-critique review loop helps produce actionable findings without generic praise or unsupported security claims.
installed_skills.changes: Removed vendor artifact paths and uninstalled companion skills; relaxed changed-line-only restriction where impact depends on unchanged code; added staging preservation and explicit authorization before publishing reviews.

installed_skills.name: Risk-based QA
installed_skills.author: The Flutter Authors; adapted by Coffee Management System maintainers
installed_skills.date: 2026-04-21: widget-test skill added; source workflow stable in an active repository
installed_skills.why: Official widget interaction/testing guidance plus local negative-case matrix covers high-impact auth/payment/stock/UI defects.
installed_skills.changes: Added Laravel/MySQL/provider isolation, explicit pumping and realistic risk selection. The separately inspected integration skill was not installed: mandatory Flutter Driver extension, MCP tools and broad pumpAndSettle use were removed in favor of version-aware official integration docs.

installed_skills.name: Safe CI maintenance
installed_skills.kind: Original project skill; documentation references only
installed_skills.author: Coffee Management System maintainers; references by GitHub
installed_skills.date: Local skill created 2026-10-05. Latest inspected GitHub page history was link/version maintenance; exact last substantive security-text edit not established.
installed_skills.why: Least-privilege CI, lockfile reproducibility, runner diagnosis and no live-provider tests match the current GitHub team workflow.
installed_skills.changes: Original guidance; no gh-fix-ci Python helper, mandatory approval-plan loop, GitHub credential scopes or deployment provider added.

installed_skills.name: Preserve Git workflow
installed_skills.kind: Original project skill; documentation references only
installed_skills.author: Coffee Management System maintainers; references by GitHub
installed_skills.date: Local skill created 2026-10-05; documentation meaningful update not independently established.
installed_skills.why: User staging, one root repository, focused review and explicit publication boundaries are more relevant than bulk Git automation.
installed_skills.changes: Original workflow referencing GitHub flow; no shell helpers, aggressive cleanup commands, hooks or automatic commit/push instructions.

installed_skills.name: API and payment security
installed_skills.category: Cybersecurity / API Security / OWASP / Secure Coding / KHQR
installed_skills.kind: Adapted upstream threat-model workflow with local domain checks
installed_skills.author: OpenAI; adapted by Coffee Management System maintainers. Reference authors: OWASP and National Bank of Cambodia
installed_skills.date: 2026-02-02: threat-model workflow added; stable source in an active repository. Local adaptation created 2026-10-05.
installed_skills.why: Language-neutral, evidence-based threat modeling fits PHP/Dart better than OpenAI's language-limited security-best-practices skill; local API/KHQR checks address the highest-impact boundaries.
installed_skills.changes: Removed Codex-specific reference/output dependencies and unconditional user-confirmation pause. Added bounded passive review, OWASP-linked endpoint checks and provider-neutral payment invariants without assuming signed callbacks or current endpoints.
